assumptions.claim: When ctrl_err_storage is false, aes_mode_q is assumed to be within {AES_ECB, AES_CBC, AES_CFB, AES_OFB, AES_CTR, AES_NONE}.

assumptions.claim: When ctrl_err_storage is false, aes_op_q is assumed to be within {AES_ENC, AES_DEC}.
assumptions.risk: An illegal operation value could lead to incorrect key usage or data leakage.
